entities.name: Selena Mistencharmer
entities.description: Artificer and mage who with Slides Stardust defeated Mandrake Nightshade and was killed by Rostov Maelstrom.

entities.name: Slides Stardust
entities.description: Companion of Selena who helped defeat Mandrake Nightshade and curse the mountain.

entities.name: Mandrake Nightshade
entities.description: Evil foe with dragons and pit lords, defeated at Mount Margalus.

entities.name: Rostov Maelstrom
entities.description: Ambushed and easily dispatched Selena in Bosconius.

entities.name: Great Magus War
entities.description: War on Antausia in which Selena fought.

entities.name: Mount Margalus
entities.description: Mountain where Mandrake was defeated, later Mandrake's Mountain and cursed.

entities.name: Bosconius
entities.description: City with Selena's laboratory, where her rainbow transforms magic.

entities.name: Antausia
entities.description: Plane of the Great Magus War.

events.summary: Selena and Slides Stardust assemble small hordes at Mount Margalus and defeat Mandrake Nightshade.
events.quote: They defeated the evil Mandrake Nightshade with his dragons and pit lords

events.summary: Fearing Mandrake's resurrection, Selena and Slides curse the mountain to drain anyone who sets foot on it.
events.quote: they put a dangerous curse on the mountain

events.summary: Rostov Maelstrom ambushes Selena in her laboratory; she shatters a celestial prism, releasing a rainbow of her power over the city, and is easily dispatched.

relations.quote: Selena and Slides Stardust assembled small hordes at Mount Margalus
They defeated the evil Mandrake Nightshade
